quote: Directors and above (excluding those on a sales commission plan) have a bonus target that's a percentage of base salary and paid twice per year (semi-annually) based on company performance.
fact: Directors and above who are not on a sales commission plan get a bonus target as a percentage of base salary, paid twice a year based on company performance.

quote: GitLab's compensation ranges typically span from -20% to +20% of the midpoint (0.80 to 1.20 compa-ratio).
fact: GitLab pay ranges usually run from 20% below to 20% above the midpoint, i.e. a compa-ratio of 0.80 to 1.20.

quote: Most roles target the 50th percentile, while critical technical roles target the 75th percentile for premium positioning
fact: Most roles are benchmarked to the 50th market percentile, but critical technical roles target the 75th percentile.

quote: GitLab pays local market rates based on cost of labor, not cost of living.
fact: GitLab sets pay on local cost of labor rather than cost of living.

quote: Roles should align with at least 70-75% of Radford's job content.
fact: When matching GitLab roles to Radford survey jobs, a role must match at least 70-75% of the Radford job content.

quote: As of May 1, 2026, all team members at GitLab, regardless of location, have visibility to their compensation range in Workday.
fact: Since May 1, 2026 every team member, in any location, can see their own compensation range in Workday.

quote: **Q4 Cycle:** Promotions effective November 1
fact: Promotions from the Q4 promotion cycle take effect on November 1.

quote: Our annual cash compensation review budget for FY27 is funded at 3.5% of TTC (Total Target Cash) for all countries except for India which is funded at 7% to better align to market.
fact: The FY27 Annual Compensation Review budget is 3.5% of Total Target Cash, except India which gets 7%.

quote: October 5th to be eligible to participate in the equity refresh program
fact: To be in the equity refresh part of the Annual Compensation Review, a team member must be hired on or before October 5.

quote: This is a reversion of the prior policy put in place to use monthly rates with the reversion going into effect as of September 1, 2023.
fact: Since September 1, 2023, one-time USD bonuses are converted using set exchange rates rather than monthly rates.

quote: For an interim role to be considered, the need for coverage would need to be longer than a 30 day time period.
fact: An interim role only qualifies for interim compensation if the coverage need lasts longer than 30 days.

quote: For team members on a base salary compensation plan, your bonus will be an additional 10% of your salary for the duration of the interim role period.
fact: Salaried team members in an interim role get a bonus of an extra 10% of salary for the duration of the interim role.

quote: Total bonus payments for GTM team members in an interim management role shall not exceed $50,000 USD for a single interim leadership assignment
fact: Interim bonuses for Go-to-Market team members are capped at $50,000 USD per interim leadership assignment.

quote: Any GitLab [team member](/handbook/people-group/employment-solutions/#team-member-types-at-gitlab) in good standing may nominate anyone — including people outside their own team. Self-nominations are not permitted.
fact: Any team member in good standing can nominate anyone for a discretionary bonus, but self-nominations are not allowed.

quote: Nominations idle for 90+ days are automatically canceled.
fact: Discretionary bonus nominations that sit idle for 90 days or more are canceled automatically.

quote: Anybody can [recommend a Working Group Bonus](#process-for-recommending-working-group-bonus-in-workday) through the managers of the individuals involved for $100 per person
fact: A Working Group Bonus is $100 per person and is recommended through the managers of the people involved.

quote: The recipient of The DZ award will receive a one time cash bonus equivalent to $10,000 USD at using the local exchange rate.
fact: The DZ Award pays a one-time $10,000 USD bonus.

quote: The recipient of each value award will receive a one time cash bonus equivalent to $5,000 USD at the exchange rate.
fact: Each Values Award winner receives a one-time $5,000 USD cash bonus.

quote: We offer a referral bonus once the new team member has been employed with the company for 3 months.
fact: A referral bonus is paid only after the referred hire has been employed for 3 months.

quote: $10,000 for referrals hired to Strategic or Major Account Executive roles
fact: During the Q4 Account Executive referral incentive (Dec 8, 2025 - Feb 23, 2026), referrals hired as Strategic or Major AEs earned $10,000.

quote: While the target is 10% of base salary, payout is commensurate with performance rating and budget and may pay between 80% - 120% of target.
fact: The Corporate Bonus Plan targets 10% of base salary, with actual payout between 80% and 120% of target.

quote: This program is effective June 1, 2026. Starting in 2027, it will follow our standard fiscal year cycle, running February 1 – January 31.
fact: The Corporate Bonus Plan started June 1, 2026 and from 2027 follows the February 1 - January 31 fiscal year.

quote: If a team member leaves GitLab, they have 90 days post termination to exercise their vested options. Unvested RSUs and options are forfeited upon the date of the team member's exit from the company.
fact: Departing team members have 90 days after termination to exercise vested options; unvested RSUs and options are forfeited on exit.

quote: provides a 15% purchase price discount of the fair market value of the Company's Class A common stock on the IPO date or purchase date, whichever is lower.
fact: The ESPP gives a 15% discount on the lower of the offering-start price or the purchase-date price.

quote: Team member is employed via a GitLab entity with 50+ headcount
fact: To join the ESPP a team member must be employed by a GitLab entity with 50 or more people.

quote: Team members may be eligible to participate in the annual refresh grant cycle review if they have completed six months of service with the company.
fact: Team members need six months of service to be considered for an annual equity refresh grant.

quote: Promotion and Refresh Grants do not require a cliff, begin vesting quarterly for three-year vest.
fact: Promotion and refresh RSU grants have no cliff and vest quarterly over three years.

quote: Class B Common Stock - 10 votes per share
fact: GitLab Class B common stock carries 10 votes per share, versus 1 for Class A.

quote: That's why we provide up to $10,000 each year specifically for your career development.
fact: The Growth and Development Fund gives up to $10,000 per year for career development.

quote: Where local life insurance benefits aren't available, GitLab provides $20,000 in life insurance coverage that you can direct to any beneficiary you choose.
fact: Where there is no entity-specific life insurance, GitLab provides $20,000 of life cover to a beneficiary of the team member's choice.

quote: Flexible scheduling - take all at once or split into up to three segments
fact: GitLab's 16 weeks of paid parental leave can be taken at once or split into up to three segments.

quote: Flexible time off designed to support your overall well-being, with the option to take up to 25 consecutive calendar days for vacation.
fact: Under flexible PTO, team members can take up to 25 consecutive calendar days of vacation.

quote: GitLab has evaluated vehicle salary sacrifice and novated leasing programs across multiple regions (including Australia and the UK) and has decided not to offer these benefits at this time.
fact: GitLab decided not to offer vehicle salary sacrifice or novated leasing in any region, including Australia and the UK.

quote: **Effective 2026-02-02**, Tilt will serve as the Third Party Administrator for leaves of absence in the US and Canada
fact: From February 2, 2026, Tilt administers leaves of absence in the US and Canada.

quote: Benefits reset annually on March 20
fact: Modern Health session allowances reset every year on March 20.

quote: **Company Match:** 50% of contributions on the first 6% of earnings (up to $1,500 annually).
fact: The US 401(k) match is 50% of contributions on the first 6% of earnings, capped at $1,500 a year.

quote: Already have group medical coverage? You can opt out and receive a **$150** monthly benefit allowance while still enrolling in dental, vision, and other benefits.
fact: US team members who waive GitLab medical coverage get a $150 monthly allowance and can still enroll in dental, vision and other benefits.

quote: GitLab contributes 4% of your basic salary
fact: In the UK pension scheme GitLab contributes 4% of the team member's basic salary.

quote: Employer matching up to 3% of base salary (maximum $2,500 CAD annually).
fact: GitLab Canada matches Group RRSP contributions up to 3% of base salary, max $2,500 CAD per year.

quote: Team members can increase their contribution and GitLab matches up to 5% of annual base salary
fact: In Ireland GitLab matches pension contributions up to 5% of annual base salary.

quote: Leave longer than 1 year: Consider a backfill ensuring there will be a similar (level, scope, etc) role for the person when they return.
fact: For a team member's leave longer than a year, managers should consider a backfill so a similar role exists when the person returns.
